note: Curated from GROUND-TRUTH cam00 imagery ONLY (data/synthetic/b0c_eval/gt, frames 00000-00299), before any 300-frame arm output was read; renders36k/ and uncap/ were excluded from mask SELECTION so the event definition stays method-independent. Rects are [x0,y0,x1,y1] in the 1352x1014 cam00 raster, hand-estimated +-15 px. 'frames' lists inclusive [start,end] intervals on which the REVEALED surface is scored (occluder withdrawn). Events carry a 'class': 'dynamic_content' reveals a moving/manipulated surface, 'static_background' reveals a rigid scene surface uncovered by the cook's body. The PRIMARY endpoint is the dynamic_content class; static_background is a SECONDARY diagnostic, because the B1 operator relocates capacity into dynamic-mask regions and would not be expected to act on static background. A/B/C are carried over VERBATIM from ladder_event_masks_crb0_49.json for continuity with the frozen 50-frame dev spec; a ground-truth audit did NOT confirm them and they are excluded from the primary endpoint. Class-pooled PSNR is recovered exactly from the per-event outputs of scripts/event_ray_metrics.py as pooled_mse = sum_e(n_e * 10^(-psnr_e/10)) / sum_e(n_e) with n_e = 3 * pixel_times_e. Segment 100-149 contains no qualifying occlude-and-return reveal and segment 0-49 contains none beyond the unconfirmed inherited A/B/C.
